1.why: Sans-serif typeface at comfortable size with clear line spacing and generous padding in cards; the monospace secret is legible though unsegmented.

2.why: No italics, all-caps or dense paragraphs appear anywhere; instructions are one short line per screen.

3.why: Only a fixed ~1280px desktop-width layout is shown with a centred narrow card; no mobile rendering is evidenced and the 32-character secret would likely overflow or shrink on a phone.

4.why: Each screen has a single short plain-language sentence such as 'Use an authenticator app for payment approvals.'

5.why: The 'Six-digit authenticator code' field has no placeholder or example format shown; the only digits visible (123456) are user-typed input, not a provided example.

6.why: No screen contains a long block of text; all copy is one or two short lines.

7.why: The setup secret is displayed as static text with no copy button or copy affordance, so it must be transcribed by hand.

8.why: No QR code is offered anywhere; the instruction explicitly says 'Choose manual entry and enter this setup secret'.

9.why: No autofill/one-time-code affordances are visible; email and mobile fields appear pre-filled but there is no evidence of password-manager or OTP autofill support for the code field.

10.why: The primary blue button is visually dominant, but there is no step indicator or progress marker ('Step 2 of 4'), so the current position in the flow is unclear.

11.why: Each screen requests one main action (verify, set up, confirm code), with only a secondary 'Log out' alongside.

12.why: Confirmation appears only as terse technical log lines ('Authenticator provisioning created. Test values were written to the browser console.') rather than a plain statement of what happened and what comes next.

13.why: The code can be re-entered and resubmitted, but there is no reveal/hide toggle, no re-request or regenerate code option, and no backup-recovery-code screen is reached.

14.why: The error 'We could not complete that request. Please try again.' is non-blaming but does not state the actual problem or how to fix it.

15.why: No countdown timer or expiry warning is displayed, but nothing confirms generous time either and the TOTP code is inherently time-bound as noted in the helper text.
